PATIENT: Dmitri Lewis
MRN: 6049101
DOB: 07/18/1957
DATE OF SERVICE: 01/10/2025

HISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS:
Dmitri Lewis is a 68-year-old male presenting with bilateral knee pain. Symptoms are improved with rest. He rates the discomfort 9/10 at worst. He reports symptoms began approximately 7 weeks ago. He denies any recent travel or sick contacts. 

REVIEW OF SYSTEMS:
Reports a nonproductive cough for the past week. Positive for occasional headaches. Denies nausea, vomiting, or diarrhea. Denies shortness of breath at rest. No chest pain or palpitations.

PHYSICAL EXAM:
VITALS: BP 103/60, HR 69, RR 19, Temp 99.1F, SpO2 93% on room air.
NEUROLOGIC: Cranial nerves II-XII grossly intact. Strength 5/5 throughout.
RESPIRATORY: Clear to auscultation bilaterally, no wheezes or crackles.
EXTREMITIES: No edema, cyanosis, or clubbing. Pulses 2+ bilaterally.
PSYCHIATRIC: Appropriate mood and affect.
SKIN: Warm and dry, no lesions.
ABDOMEN: Soft, non-tender, non-distended. Normal bowel sounds.
HEENT: Normocephalic, atraumatic. Mucous membranes moist.

LABS:
WBC 6.1, Hgb 14.4, Plt 152. TSH within reference range. Sodium 134, Potassium 4.7, Creatinine 0.95. Basic metabolic panel otherwise within normal limits. LDL 149 mg/dL.

Electronically signed by S. Wright, MD on 09/20/2025.
